name: deva
description: A personal Microsoft-style DSA OA practice lab.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @deva/server" "npm run dev -w @deva/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @deva/web && npm run build -w @deva/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @deva/server && npm run test -w @deva/web
